title: ACQ Provider Facts
description: Host-materialised, read-only self-registration record for a provider kit. Validated by acq host-side before the sandbox is created; the resulting directory is mounted read-only at /var/lib/acq/host/models/providers/<providerId>/. See integrations/isolation/docs/decisions/0004-neutral-model-provider-discovery.md §Layer 1.

schemaVersion.description: Schema identifier and version. Consumers MUST reject a document whose schemaVersion they do not recognise.

providerId.description: Stable, lowercase slug used as a filesystem path segment under /var/lib/acq/host/models/providers/<providerId>/. Allowed: lowercase ASCII alphanumerics and internal hyphens, 1-32 characters total. Disallowed: path separators, dots, underscores, uppercase, non-ASCII, leading/trailing hyphens, whitespace, and control characters. The pattern ends with (?![\s\S]) — a zero-width assertion that matches only at the true end of the string — rather than $ because JSON Schema (ECMA regex) and Python re both allow $ to match before a trailing newline, which would permit 'usai\n' as a path segment. The (?![\s\S]) lookahead has no such exception and enforces fullmatch semantics portably.

apiProtocol.description: Wire protocol spoken by this provider's API. Harness renderers map this bounded value through a harness-owned static allowlist without branching on providerId. Version 1 supports only the OpenAI-compatible REST protocol used by the providers proven in this milestone; additional protocols require their own neutral authentication/routing facts and concrete renderer support before this enum expands.

host.description: Authoritative DNS hostname for the provider's API endpoint, without a scheme or port. Used by the orchestrator for SSRF containment: modelsUrl MUST have the same host as this field. Each DNS label rejects empty labels and leading/trailing hyphens. The host-time validator rejects IP literals and verifies this host against the kit network allowlist. The pattern uses (?![\s\S]) instead of $ for the same newline-bypass reason as providerId.

baseUrl.description: Full base URL for the provider's API (https:// required). Informational; consumers MUST NOT fetch arbitrary paths under this URL without host cross-check against the `host` field. Note: the `format: uri` keyword is not enforced by default in all JSON Schema implementations (including Python jsonschema); the `pattern: ^https://` is the load-bearing constraint.

modelsUrl.description: Full URL the orchestrator fetches to obtain the live model list (https:// required). The schema does NOT enforce that modelsUrl's hostname equals the `host` field — that cross-check is the orchestrator's responsibility (ADR 0004 §Layer 2 SSRF containment). A mismatch is a hard failure for that provider at the orchestrator level, not at schema-parse time. Note: `format: uri` is advisory only in most implementations; the `pattern` is the binding constraint.

keyEnv.description: NAME of the environment variable holding the provider API key — never the key value itself. acq validates host-side that this name matches a variable in the same kit's own spec.yaml environment: block (env-var ownership check). Only the bounded-fetch helper reads this credential; it is never passed to the provider's normalizer. Uses (?![\s\S]) instead of $ for the same newline-bypass reason as providerId.
